title: Quantitative uniqueness properties for functions on compact quasi-analytic manifolds
summary: In this article, we establish quantitative uniqueness results for a class of functions defined on a quasi-analytic compact manifold $X$ without boundary. This function class is characterized by the iterates of a positive elliptic linear differential operator on $X$ and, notably, encompasses all functions with a finite spectrum. By employing a relatively dense observable set, we extend classical Logvinenko-Sereda-type results to this quasi-analytic framework.
